name: VideoLayout

component.name: VideoLayout
component.description: Arranges participant videos in an evenly sized grid. The number of videos shown is limited by the device's video capabilities.

props.name: participants
props.description: Participants to display, in order. Displays as many as the device supports.

props.name: minTileWidth
props.description: Minimum tile width in pixels. The layout picks the row and column count that gives the largest tiles at least this wide, and tiles never get narrower than this. If no arrangement fits, tiles are still this wide, so the grid extends past the container and is clipped at its edges.

props.name: gap
props.description: Pixel gap between tiles in both axes.

props.name: videoTileAspectRatio
props.description: Width-to-height ratio for each participant tile.

props.name: activeSpeakerBorder
props.description: Highlights the active video participant when the session has more than two participants.

notes: Tiles are displayed only while the session is connected.
When the device cannot render multiple videos, only the first participant is rendered.
Rows are centered, including a partly filled last row.
Video quality for each tile is chosen automatically from the number and size of tiles.

types.name: Participant
types.description: Zoom Video SDK Participant type, also exported by this package.
